name: Banh canh Long Huong
summary: Bánh canh Long Hương is a Bà Rịa breakfast of translucent, chewy-soft noodles in a rich bone broth, usually with fish cake, pork hock, or shrimp and pork. Herbs, scallion, and ground pepper finish the bowl.
origin: Long Hương, Bà Rịa, at 11 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám.
texture: The noodles are translucent and white, chewy and soft.
taste: The broth is rich from simmered bones, finished with herbs, scallion, and ground pepper.
howToEat: Eat it at breakfast. The bowl is in Bà Rịa, not on the Vung Tau peninsula.
where: 11 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám, Long Hương, Bà Rịa.
seoTitle: Banh canh Long Huong — a Ba Ria breakfast bowl
seoDescription: Bánh canh Long Hương is a Bà Rịa breakfast: translucent chewy noodles in a rich bone broth with fish cake, pork hock, or shrimp and pork.
